title: External Cech cup as ordinary cup after projection refinements
statement: For a field k, schemes X,Y over Spec k, arbitrary open families U,V, modules F,G, and degrees p,q, let h be a k-linear bidegree map satisfying the prescribed external Alexander--Whitney coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. Let W be the product open family of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Identify scalar and module Cech complexes additively through their explicit section coordinates. Let gamma_X and gamma_Y be the unique projection refinement cochain maps of [def-sc-cech-refinement-cochain-map] into Cech(W,pr_1^*F) and Cech(W,pr_2^*G). For every a in scalar degree p and b in scalar degree q, the additive identification of h(a tensor_k b) equals the ordinary Cech cup [def-sc-cech-cup-product] of gamma_X(a) and gamma_Y(b). No differential identity is assumed, and no covering, finiteness or quasicoherence hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Proof, refinement cochain formula; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07MB, Alexander--Whitney component; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech. Official pages read 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Compose the scalar and module explicit additive Cech isomorphisms. They have definitionally identical explicit section complexes, hence this is an additive complex isomorphism whose coordinate action is the identity.

Take the unique refinement cochain map along each projection, refining U and V to the product family by Prod.fst and Prod.snd. Infimum projections supply the refinement inequalities. The existing uniqueness theorem fixes all degree components and ensures chosen data are uniquely determined.

Apply target Cech coordinate injectivity and the prescribed external bidegree coordinate formula. Expand ordinary cup and the refinement coordinates. Composed restrictions coincide with direct restrictions because opens form a thin category; use TopCat.Presheaf.map_homOfLE_map_homOfLE_apply. Tensor-section congruence proves the coordinate equality in each factor.

theorem externalCup_bidegree_refinement
    {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
          (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) :
    (externalCupScalarCechIso (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).hom.f (p + q)
        (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
      cechCupCochain
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) p q
        ((externalCupRefineCech (pullback.fst f g) U _ Prod.fst
          (fun _ ↦ inf_le_left) F).f p ((externalCupScalarCechIso f U F).hom.f p a))
        ((externalCupRefineCech (pullback.snd f g) V _ Prod.snd
          (fun _ ↦ inf_le_right) G).f q ((externalCupScalarCechIso g V G).hom.f q b))
